Most informative source. Lists all 41 certified criteria, 6 CQMs (depression, BMI, tobacco, falls, dementia, kidney health), product description, EMR Direct for secure messaging, pricing note about Direct messaging subscription.
EHI export documentation page — appeared to show same Coming Soon / minimal content as main site at time of research.

SLI Compliance usability test report (Dec 2024). Describes BroadStreet as for Post Acute/Long Term Care and clinical/ambulatory settings. Mentions 'unique task architecture' and tested tasks for demographics, implantable devices, labs, diagnostics, medications, and reconciliation.

WashSense is 'part of the Arsana Health Multi-Provider Integrated Platform.' Smart handwashing devices for infection control. Same parent entity as BroadStreet Health LLC — contact email (laura@washsense.com) is shared.

Describes Arsana/WashSense post-acute capabilities: infection surveillance, cross-contamination mapping, chronic care management, remote clinical evaluation, advanced care planning, hospital diversion.

CORI Innovation Fund investment in Arsana Health. Describes Arsana as maker of software and hardware solutions for post-acute care (SNFs, assisted living). Arsana Health Portal combines records from facilities, doctors, labs, pharmacies. Connor Dahlberg is founder/CEO.

Center on Rural Innovation profile of Arsana Health. Based at Black River Innovation Campus, Springfield, VT. Founded by Connor Dahlberg. AI-powered analytics for health risk detection. Focus on fragmented, under-resourced care settings.
WashSense org chart: 1-10 employees. Connor Dahlberg (CEO), Laura Ivanoski (VP Finance & Ops), Vincent Fusca III (CRO).
BroadStreet portal hosted on Arsana Health domain. Connection refused at time of research — confirms BroadStreet is part of Arsana Health platform.
